title: BCCDC-PHL/threshold pipeline - params.project_expected_taxids schema
description: Expected taxa per project: one row per project_id + expected_taxid pair; a project may appear on several rows.

project_id.errorMessage: project_id may only contain letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens and dots (as in the samplesheet)

expected_taxid.errorMessage: expected_taxid must be an NCBI taxid (a positive integer, e.g. 543 for Enterobacteriaceae)

taxon_name.errorMessage: taxon_name may only contain letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens, dots and spaces.
